# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-313#speed-up-cursor-session-checks

**Verdict: Caught.**

**Next proof action.** No new proof action for the observed Recover refusal path: the maintained `toContainText(scopeRefusal)` assertion already fails when missing/unreadable scope falls through to shared-configuration continuation. Leave any broader lean-stale-join or family-wall-time probes to a separately authorized check.

**Story and revision.** SEED-313#speed-up-cursor-session-checks (`.planning/seeds/SEED-313-cursor-session-checks.md#speed-up-cursor-session-checks`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/593-speed-up-cursor-session-checks/PLAN.md`, revision `1d8765b040b63e0641fd43fd4715a59e4c497c71`. Checked in an isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-313-speed-up-cursor-session-checks-scratch` (pre-probe and post-restore state: only `?? node_modules` symlink into the execution checkout; 0 product paths dirty). Execution worktree `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/speed-up-cursor-session-checks` was not edited.

**Promise.** Key example / scope: missing or unreadable recorded scope refuses Recover (and Open terminal) with the saved-configuration explanation and spawns nothing against shared Cursor configuration. Expected observable behavior on Recover after an unreadable `cli-config.json`: the Taken entry shows the refusal explanation and attach/call counts stay unchanged.

**Fault.** `dashboard/server/hosts/cursor/sessionScope.ts`, `recordedCursorSessionScope` catch path: replaced the `kind: "unavailable"` refusal (with the saved-configuration explanation) with `return { kind: "none" }`, so a missing/unreadable recorded scope continued as Default shared-configuration behavior. Fixtures and assertions were left intact.

**Checks examined.** Focused ordinary Playwright command (same for baseline, faulted, and restored):

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard -- \
  --workers=1 \
  dashboard/tests/sessions/cursor-session-scope-continuation.spec.ts \
  -g 'a missing or unreadable recorded scope refuses'
```

Owner case: `a missing or unreadable recorded scope refuses recovery and terminal open, spawning nothing` in `dashboard/tests/sessions/cursor-session-scope-continuation.spec.ts`. Catching assertion: `await expect(entry).toContainText(scopeRefusal)` at line 181 (substring `The Cursor configuration saved for this session is missing or cannot be read`), reached after Recover click on the unreadable-scope setup. Downstream spawn-nothing asserts at lines 185–186 were not reached once the explanation assert failed. Caller hints about lean stale-phase PTY join and family wall-time ≥10 s were treated as suggestions and not probed in this check.

**Reach.** Baseline (after competing open-dough dashboard Playwright cleared; first attempt timed out on Recover under load averages ~48–53 with two rival suites): pass, `/usr/bin/time` `real 30.46`. Faulted run exercised the same Recover-after-unreadable-scope transition and failed at the refusal-text assertion (`real 33.48`). Restored run passed (`real 25.24`). Host remained on AC Power throughout.

**Wrong behavior.** Independently of which assertion fired first: after Recover, the Taken entry showed `Ready for review` (successful continuation) and no refusal text, instead of the saved-configuration explanation. That matches the faulted product path treating unreadable scope as `kind: "none"` and continuing through shared configuration.

**Restoration.** Restored `sessionScope.ts` from the pre-fault backup and `git checkout --` against the scratch HEAD; `git status --porcelain` returned only `?? node_modules` (matches pre-probe). Diff against the original backup was empty. Restored focused check passed.

**Already-planned disposition.** None matched beyond the story’s retained family ownership of this refusal case; this probe does not create a new repair decision.

- **Decision:** No Intent Coverage follow-up. No new proof action and no backlog correction for the probed path. Broader lean-stale-join / family-wall-time probes were not in this check and need separate authorization if pursued.

- **Deferred process review:** Completed from coordinator transcript `a6169ce7-5db3-4970-8f00-c8bf8c548fb4` plus retained timing under `/tmp/slice{1,2,3}-593*`.
